annotation.title_clean: Council Directive 78/547/EEC of 12 June 1978 amending Directive 70/156/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.title_en: Council Directive 78/547/EEC of 12 June 1978 amending Directive 70/156/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 168
annotation.summary_en: 1978 Council Directive amending the EEC motor vehicle type-approval Directive 70/156/EEC by adding passenger compartment heating systems and wheel guards to the model information document and type-approval certificate. It has no AI content; it is relevant only as historical vehicle type-approval law.
key_provisions_or_claims: Annex I of Directive 70/156/EEC adds items for heating systems and wheel guards
Annex II type-approval certificate supplemented with the same items
Member States must comply within 18 months of notification
